title: Do you refrain from watching fond films from your past, for fear of not liking them now?

commenti.body: A lot of my favorites benefit from nostalgia and I likely wouldn’t enjoy them as much if it wasn’t for that reason.  There are some films though I used to watch so often that I never really need to see again so are they still my favorites if I never want to watch them?  I don’t want to see Back to the Future or Pulp Fiction again because I know them so well but I fear I will be bored because of that, whereas I’ve seen other films just as many times but can still enjoy and look forward to a rewatch.
